convert_audioldm2_checkpoint_to_diffuser: convert an original AudioLDM2 checkpoint file to a diffusers AudioLDM2Pipeline and save it to disk
convert_ldm_unet_checkpoint: convert an original AudioLDM2 UNet checkpoint state dict to the diffusers UNet format with EMA extraction support
convert_ldm_vae_checkpoint: convert an original AudioLDM2 VAE checkpoint state dict to the diffusers AutoencoderKL format
convert_open_clap_checkpoint: convert an original AudioLDM2 CLAP checkpoint state dict to the transformers ClapModel format
convert_hifigan_checkpoint: convert an original AudioLDM2 HiFiGAN vocoder checkpoint state dict to the transformers SpeechT5HifiGan format
